title: SLM 3D printing of complex pod geometries
description: Selective laser melting of complex titanium pod housings with internal lattice structures.

processComparison.laser: ≥ 98% of wrought with proper heat treatment

processDescription: Selective Laser Melting (SLM/DMLS) builds titanium components layer-by-layer from metal powder using a fiber laser. Internal lattice structures, conformal cooling channels, and organic geometries are achievable that are unattainable with manufacturing.
heatControl: Build chamber inerted with argon to < 1000 ppm O₂. Build plate preheated to 200°C to reduce thermal gradients between layers.
flatnessControl: Stress relief annealing (540°C / 2 hr) before substrate removal. HIP for critical aerospace/medical components to eliminate internal porosity.
capabilitiesDescription: Our facility is equipped to handle slm 3d printing of complex pod geometries with full process control, SPC monitoring, and certified quality management.

downstreamProcesses.name: Support Removal
downstreamProcesses.description: EDM or CNC machining to remove build supports from substrate plate.

downstreamProcesses.name: Hot Isostatic Pressing (HIP)
downstreamProcesses.description: HIP at 920°C / 100 MPa to close internal porosity.

downstreamProcesses.name: CNC Finish Machining
downstreamProcesses.description: 5-axis CNC machining of critical mating surfaces.

downstreamProcesses.description: Deburring for slm 3d printing of complex pod geometries components.
